Alpine's security tracker marks musl 1.2.6-r3 in the 3.24-main branch fixed because that stable package includes the regcomp integer-overflow patch. Scout incorrectly compares the stable package against edge's 1.2.6-r6 release. See https://security.alpinelinux.org/vuln/CVE-2026-107891

Alpine aports 3.24-stable musl 1.2.6-r3 applies CVE-2026-107891.patch (musl upstream commit 7813e9119eb5fe681b6750b8a033a0490bca0941, regex regcomp integer overflow). Alpine secdb lists 1.2.6-r6 as the fixed package revision before that patch is present on the stable branch at pkgrel 3. Advisory: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-107891
